notes.subject: מעף ביעף
notes.rationale: Same root y-'-p used twice (wearied-flight / in-weary-flight) — paronomasia; KJV takes it as passive 'being caused to fly swiftly', JPS as 'came in swift flight'.

notes.subject: מעף
notes.rationale: Either 'flying swiftly' (flight) or 'wearied/exhausted' (from flight) — the root means to tire; Bambara keeps the doubled picture kana / kana-teliya.

notes.subject: מעף ביעף
notes.rationale: Read as 'in extreme weariness' — Gabriel arrives exhausted from the flight, matching the root sense 'to tire from wearisome flight'.

translation: Nka ne tun bɛ kuma-fɔ da dɔɔni, mɔgɔ kelen, Gavriyel (Gabriel), min ne ye a ye ɲɛnamaya la daminɛ na, a bɛ tugu ne fɛ ni kana-teliya ye, a ye bolo sigi ne la wula sanubiyabɔ waati la.

tokens.gloss: a bɛ tugu ni kana ye
